problem: Let $u$ and $v$ be vectors such that $‖v‖=7$ and $‖2u+v‖=25.$  If $u$ is orthogonal to $v$, find $‖u‖.$
worked_solution:
Since $u$ is orthogonal to $v,$ we also have that $2u$ is orthogonal to $v.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem states that

$$
\begin{aligned}‖2u+v{‖}^{2} & =‖2u{‖}^{2}+‖v{‖}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying and substituting in the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖2u+v{‖}^{2} & =(2‖u‖)^{2}+‖v{‖}^{2} \\ ‖2u+v{‖}^{2} & =4‖u{‖}^{2}+‖v{‖}^{2} \\ (25)^{2} & =4‖u{‖}^{2}+(7)^{2} \\ 625 & =4‖u{‖}^{2}+49 \\ 576 & =4‖u{‖}^{2} \\ ‖u{‖}^{2} & =144\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $‖u‖=12.$
